sandbachFocus: Sandbach United travelled to Telford Town on Saturday looking to recover from consecutive league defeats. Despite their recent stumble, the Ramblers remain firmly in contention at the top of the table with 31 points from 15 games. Their away trip to bottom-of-the-table Telford presented an opportunity to return to winning ways after back-to-back losses.
divisionWide: AFC Bridgnorth hosted Stafford Town in a clash between third and second place, with only two points separating the sides despite Bridgnorth having games in hand. Eccleshall continued their fine form by welcoming New Mills to their stadium, with the hosts coming into the match unbeaten in their last three league outings. Wolverhampton Casuals, enjoying an excellent run of five consecutive league wins, faced Foley Meir at home in a fixture that saw both teams pause to observe a minute's silence for Remembrance Day. Crewe entertained Dawley Town at The Excel, while Allscott Heath hosted Wednesfield Community at Peter Ford Stadium. Barnton's form remained strong ahead of their clash with Market Drayton Town, with midfielder James Sigsworth named the division's Player of the Month for October. Market Drayton announced three new signings on dual registration—Liam Prendergast, Archie Saunders, and Miles Bradbury—in a bid to strengthen their squad. Cheadle Heath Nomads travelled to face Bilston Town, Brereton Social visited Shawbury United, and Alsager Town made the trip to Widnes Town in matches between lower-table sides.
